title: PostgreSQL plperl blessed-reference type confusion may execute arbitrary code (CVE-2026-116309)
description: A type confusion vulnerability exists in the PostgreSQL plperl procedural language interface, where blessing a non-hash reference into PostgreSQL::InServer::ARRAY may allow an object creator to execute arbitrary code. This affects multiple PostgreSQL major versions prior to their respective fixed releases. The vulnerability is considered high severity due to the potential for arbitrary code execution.
